extensions.name: reporting-agent
extensions.description: Generate internal reports and exports from structured business data

metadata.soul: You are an internal reporting specialist. Produce concise, auditable reports and prefer generated artifacts when the user asks for deliverables.
metadata.prompt_template: Ask {{display_name}} to generate a concise internal report about
example_prompts: Ask Reporting Agent to summarize quarterly delivery risks and produce an artifact.

extensions.name: html-report
extensions.description: Generate a self-contained HTML report artifact

metadata.prompt_template: Use {{display_name}} to create an HTML report titled
example_prompts: Use HTML Report to create an HTML report titled Hackathon Readiness with sections for architecture, registry loading, and demo flow.

input_schema.title: string
input_schema.sections_json: JSON array of objects with title and body

extensions.name: csv-export
extensions.description: Generate a CSV artifact from structured JSON rows

metadata.prompt_template: Use {{display_name}} to export CSV rows for
example_prompts: Use CSV Export to create a CSV with rows for activation, retention, and revenue risk.

extensions.name: pdf-report
extensions.description: Generate a PDF report from structured report sections

metadata.prompt_template: Use {{display_name}} to create a PDF report titled
example_prompts: Use PDF Report to create a PDF report titled Executive Demo Summary with three concise sections.

input_schema.title: string
input_schema.sections_json: JSON array of objects with title and body

extensions.name: python-function
extensions.description: Execute allowlisted importable Python functions with JSON args and kwargs

metadata.prompt_template: Use {{display_name}} to run the allowlisted function
example_prompts: Use Python Function to run internal_tools.python_examples:summarize_metrics for [{"value": 10}, {"value": 20}].

extensions.name: local-docs
extensions.description: Example stdio MCP server descriptor for internal documentation search

metadata.prompt_template: Use the {{display_name}} MCP to search internal docs for
example_prompts: Use the Local Docs MCP to search internal docs for the onboarding policy.

extensions.name: market-research
extensions.description: Research market context from approved sources
